claims.text: Each offer's monthly payment is the standard fixed-rate payment, exact to the cent.
Total paid is the sum of every monthly payment for that offer, exact to the cent.
Total interest is the sum of each month's interest, rounded half up to the cent each month.
Cost of borrowing is total interest plus the upfront fees you typed for that offer.
The page names the offer or offers with the lowest cost of borrowing. It states a fact and gives no advice.
The page names the offer or offers with the lowest monthly payment. It states a fact and gives no advice.
When offers tie, every tied offer is named and none is picked over the others.
A rate of 0, a one-month loan and a 1,200-month loan all work out exactly.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the offer and the field.
